name: IPtoASN
tier_rationale: Well-known community project with an identifiable maintainer, public documentation and a public-domain (PDDL) dataset published for years (A8 community; P047 chair: 'tier community is the lowest dataset operator (IPtoASN, bgp.tools)').

reliability.justification: Derived from global BGP table dumps; ranges and AS names are accurate at the snapshot date (monthly releases observed).

ip2asn.title: IPtoASN ip2asn-v4/v6 TSV (range start, range end, AS number, country, AS description)

terms.quote: Registry terms: DB-IP Lite CC BY 4.0 (open), IPtoASN PDDL (open), bgp.tools free use with descriptive UA (open), GeoLite2 EULA (license).

ip2asn.notes: Quote: binding council text (P047 cond 7); research C0086 terms 'PDDL (public domain)' (verified_live 200, v4 8.7 MB gz and v6 2.3 MB gz, Last-Modified 2026-11-01). Fetched only by `v3lum data update` (at most daily), loaded into the shared range index (P034); the v6 file is dataset ip_offline_db.iptoasn_v6.tsv. Used by ip_offline_db.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P047). No value is ever sent: the files are downloaded whole and matched locally.
